svg.title: Validation score during training, every version, both conditions
svg.desc: Lines per version of the controller, score against training step. Up to step 4,000 every run is still training; later points rest on the few runs that had not stopped, drawn hollow with their run count.
svg.text: Solid points: every run still training.
Hollow points: only n runs had not yet
stopped, so they are weak evidence.
